title: Committee of Supply – Head Q (Ministry of Communications and Information)
what_it_is: Committee of Supply – Head Q (Ministry of Communications and Information)

sections.label: Singapore tech services startup growth
sections.summary: Tech services startups nearly tripled from 1,539 in 2004 to 4,380 in 2014, with 30,000 ICT jobs expected by 2020.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: According to TechSG, technology services represent the fastest growing startup sector in Singapore, almost tripling, from 1,539 in 2004 to 4,380 in 2014.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: Over the last five years, the number of tech services start-ups grew at 16% per annum, compared to average growth of 9% in other sectors.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: Also, the tech services sector saw the highest employment growth of 11% per annum compared to an average growth of 3% per annum for startups in other sectors.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: Overall, the Government has indicated that 30,000 information and communication technology (ICT) jobs are expected to be filled over the next five years up to 2020.

sections.label: Cybersecurity rules for critical infrastructure
sections.summary: The passage asks whether the Ministry has regulations enforcing cybersecurity standards for critical infrastructure providers and how it ensures boards recognise risks.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: To protect our national interests, does the Ministry have in place regulations that enforce a required standard of cybersecurity measures or cyber risk management framework that critical infrastructure providers, such as telecommunications, transport, energy and utility providers, as well as institutions dealing with financial transactions, to safeguard our people and businesses here?

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: How does the Ministry ensure that boards and senior executives of such firms, and even our Government agencies recognise the risks involved and are committed to invest to protect the interests of their firm and organisations for the interest of customers and the nation?

sections.label: Additional legislation to strengthen laws
sections.summary: The passage asks whether the Ministry is considering additional pieces of legislation to strengthen laws.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: Are there additional pieces of legislation that the Ministry is considering to strengthen our laws?

sections.label: Handling foreign concerted attacks
sections.summary: The passage asks how the Government handles concerted attacks by foreign governments or groups originating from foreign countries.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: How does the Government handle concerted attacks either by foreign governments or groups originating from foreign countries?

sections.label: Training for mid-career professionals
sections.summary: The passage asks whether sufficient company-led training and conversion programmes exist for mid-career professionals to meet manpower needs by 2017.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
sentences.text: Given the expected number of specialists required by 2017, are there sufficient company-led training and effective conversion programmes for mid-career professionals, so that we have a decent shot at meeting our manpower needs by 2017?

sections.label: New York Fed blocked transfers
sections.summary: The Federal Reserve Bank of New York prevented about $850 million from being moved, but more than $100 million was still transferred out.

sentences.speaker: Mr Vikram Nair (Sembawang)
sentences.text: The Federal Reserve Bank of New York managed to prevent about $850 million from being moved but more than $100 million was still transferred out.

sections.label: Proposed CSA legislation powers
sections.summary: Minister Yaacob Ibrahim announced in January that new legislation was intended to give CSA new and wider powers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Vikram Nair (Sembawang)
sentences.text: Minister Yaacob Ibrahim also announced in January this year that new legislation was intended to provide CSA with new and wider powers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Vikram Nair (Sembawang)
sentences.text: What does the proposed legislation add to the existing law, which is covered by the Computer Misuse and Cyber Security Act?

sections.label: Public Service Broadcast funding increase
sections.summary: The Government increased PSB funding and in 2015 announced $250 million a year from FY2015 to FY2019.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ganesh Rajaram (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: The Government has increased the quantum of Public Service Broadcast (PSB) funding and, in 2015, announced $250 million a year in funding from financial year (FY) 2015 to FY2019 to be disbursed.

sections.label: Toggle views and Mediacorp outsourcing
sections.summary: Toggle averaged about 135,000 weekly views, 5.5 million watched Tanglin, and Mediacorp outsources 40% of PSB-funded projects.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ganesh Rajaram (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Average weekly views on Toggle are about 135,000 and reached 194,000 in the last week of March.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ganesh Rajaram (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: So far, since the launch of "Tanglin" in June 2015, 5.5 million people have watched the show on Toggle.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ganesh Rajaram (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Mediacorp today outsources 40% of PSB-funded projects to production houses; there are about 80 to 90 SMEs in this sector.

sections.label: Fewer Singaporean companies going overseas
sections.summary: In recent years, fewer and fewer Singaporean production companies are venturing beyond Singapore's shores.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ganesh Rajaram (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: In recent years, we are seeing fewer and fewer Singaporean production companies venturing beyond our shores.

sections.label: Infinite Studios and Iskandar competition
sections.summary: Infinite Studios houses Singapore's largest sound stages, but Iskandar in Johor has overtaken much regional production and post-production services.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ganesh Rajaram (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: A major part of this ecosystem is Infinite Studios which houses Singapore's largest sound stages.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ganesh Rajaram (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: But, today, Iskandar in Johor has overtaken much of the production and post-production services in the region.

sections.label: Malaysia production rebate
sections.summary: Spending RM5 million in production expense gives a 30% rebate, making Singapore the No 2 port of call in this sector.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ganesh Rajaram (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Spend RM5 million in production expense and you immediately get a 30% rebate!

sentences.speaker: Mr Ganesh Rajaram (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: And this has effectively meant that Singapore has become the No 2 port of call in this sector.

sections.label: Infocomm sector revenue growth
sections.summary: Between 2001 and 2014, total revenue of the local and export market for the overall infocomm sector grew at a compound annual rate of 14%.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Randolph Tan (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Between 2001 and 2014, total revenue of the local and export market for the overall infocomm sector grew at a compound annual rate of 14%.

sections.label: Hardware segment revenue share
sections.summary: The hardware segment expanded its contribution to overall revenue from 54% in 2008 to 69% in 2014.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Randolph Tan (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: In recent years, the hardware segment has been expanding the proportion of its contribution to overall revenue, from 54% in 2008 to 69% in 2014.

sections.label: Infocomm growth and GDP share
sections.summary: Infocomm contributed 0.2 percentage points to overall economic growth, but its share of GDP shrank from 4.2% to 3.8% between 2001 and 2014.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Randolph Tan (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Although its contribution of 0.2 percentage points to overall economic growth appeared small, this was important in achieving the overall two percentage point growth that we had last year.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Randolph Tan (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: However, the proportion of infocomm output in overall gross domestic product (GDP) shrank from 4.2% to 3.8% between 2001 and 2014.

sections.label: Content and software revenue shares
sections.summary: From 2008 to 2014, content services revenue contribution stayed flat at 2% while software shrank from 18% to 12%.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Randolph Tan (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: To contrast what I had said earlier about the expanding contributions of the hardware segments, in more recent years, from 2008 to 2014, the contribution of revenue from content services has remained flat at 2%, while that for software shrank from 18% to 12%.

sections.label: Expected infocomm job demand
sections.summary: With Smart Nation initiatives, an additional demand of 30,000 infocomm jobs is expected to be filled by 2020.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: Together with our Smart Nation initiatives, we expect an additional demand of 30,000 infocomm jobs to be filled by 2020.

sections.label: Funding for infocomm training
sections.summary: Efforts will focus on high demand areas, with $120 million set aside to support training in infocomm manpower capabilities.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: We will focus our efforts in high demand areas such as software development, data analytics, cyber security, and network and infrastructure.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: We will, hence, set aside $120 million to support training efforts in developing infocomm manpower capabilities to address immediate and future manpower needs.

sections.label: Increase professional supply by 2,400
sections.summary: Over three years, the aim is to increase the supply of professionals by 2,400.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: Over three years, we hope to increase the supply of professionals by 2,400.

sections.label: Expanding CLT programmes
sections.summary: Every Google programme participant found a job, so CLT programmes will expand to help over a thousand professionals yearly, up from 160.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: In fact, every single participant in Google's programme found a job after the programme.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: Hence, we will expand our CLT programmes to help more than a thousand professionals each year, compared to 160 today.

sections.label: Proxor skills validation platform partnership
sections.summary: A partnership with Proxor, a Carnegie Mellon University spinoff, introduces a skills validation platform for employers to test potential employees' skills.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: To this end, we have already partnered Proxor, a Carnegie Mellon University spinoff, to introduce their skills validation platform, so that employers can use it to test potential employees' skills in solving realistic problems, rather than referring only to academic qualifications.

sections.label: GSC benefits Singaporean game companies
sections.summary: In five years, GSC benefited close to 50 Singaporean game companies, with three-quarters completing games or demonstrations and over five securing seed funding.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: In fact, in just five years, GSC has benefited close to 50 Singaporean game companies, of which, three-quarters have successfully completed games or game demonstrations with more than 20 commercial game releases.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: In addition, more than five of them have gone on to secure seed funding from about $100,000 to $2 million.

sections.label: Monetary award for course expenses
sections.summary: Recipients will receive a $5,000 monetary award to defray out-of-pocket expenses for the course they take.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: Recipients will receive a monetary award of $5,000 which can be used to defray out-of-pocket expenses associated with the course that they will take.

sections.label: Virus software usage in 2014
sections.summary: In 2014, 94% of companies used virus-checking or protection software, while 81% of home Internet users had anti-virus software installed.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: In 2014, 94% of companies used virus-checking or protection software, while 81% of home Internet users had anti-virus software installed on their computers.

sections.label: Cyber Star operational capability
sections.summary: The successful conclusion of Cyber Star marked CSA's achievement of initial operational capability.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: The successful conclusion of Cyber Star marked CSA's achievement of initial operational capability.

sections.label: Standalone Cyber Security Act
sections.summary: Work will commence on a standalone Cyber Security Act, to be tabled in Parliament in 2017, with CSA empowered to manage cyber incidents.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: We need to likewise strengthen Singapore's cybersecurity legislation.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: We will commence work on developing a standalone Cyber Security Act that provides for stronger and more proactive powers Mr Christopher de Souza, during the Budget debate, asked for an update on the timeline.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: It will also empower CSA to manage cyber incidents and raise the standards of cybersecurity providers in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: We look forward to Members supporting the Bill when it is tabled in Parliament in 2017.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: This is the necessary foundation for a successful digital economy.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: We are also ramping up our efforts to grow a strong Singapore Core in the infocomm, media and design sectors, sectors that offer good jobs for Singaporeans, and also play an important role in helping to transform the rest of the economy towards an innovation-led growth.

sections.label: 2G pre-paid plan costs
sections.summary: Customers may pay more after transiting from 2G pre-paid plans after April 2017, and a Member asked about elderly Singaporeans and possible telco vouchers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Customers are also likely to pay more when they transit from 2G pre-paid plans after April 2017.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: It is known that seven out of 10 of the 250,000 affected individuals are on pre-paid plans.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Can the Minister share how many elderly Singaporeans are represented in this group?

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Can I enquire if IDA will consider working with the three telecoms companies (telcos) to consider a special upgrade or rebate voucher for elderly Singaporeans on pre-paid plans who would likely see higher bills after April 2017?

sections.label: R&D funding commitment
sections.summary: The Government committed $19 billion to a five-year plan for research and development.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat
sentences.text: The Government has made a sound investment with its commitment of $19 billion to a five-year plan for research and development (R&D).

sections.label: Wireless@SG speed and hotspots
sections.summary: Wireless@SG speed will increase from two Mbps to five Mbps, and hotspots will double from 10,000 to 20,000 by 2018.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: It is already faster than most public wi-fi services around the world.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: But demand is increasing and so we will increase its speed from the current two megabits per second (Mbps) to five Mbps This is faster than existing 3G speeds.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: It will be more than enough to surf the web and stream high-definition videos.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: Also, we will double the number of Wireless@SG hotspots from 10,000 to 20,000 across Singapore by 2018.

sections.label: Smart Nation research funding
sections.summary: Of the $19-billion fund, $400 million goes to the Services and Digital Economy domain, and a new Smart Systems Strategic Research Programme launches this month.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: Out of the $19-billion fund announced by Prime Minister Lee earlier this year, $400 million will go to support the Services and Digital Economy (SDE) domain to drive research and innovation for our Smart Nation.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: A new Smart Systems Strategic Research Programme (SS SRP) will be launched this month.

sections.label: BASH and IIPL startup numbers
sections.summary: BASH has built 65 start-ups in one year, and IIPL has accelerated about 230 startups including the 65 from BASH.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: BASH has built 65 amazing start-ups in the one year that it has been operating.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: Across the whole of Singapore, IIPL has accelerated about 230 startups, including the 65 from BASH.

sections.label: Startup survival rate increase
sections.summary: The survival rate under the strategy has increased significantly from 10% to more than 60%.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: The survival rate, under our strategy, has increased significantly from 10% to more than 60%.

sections.label: Applications received in three days
sections.summary: In the first three days alone, about 100 applications were received, many from people in top software firms.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: In the first three days alone, we received about 100 applications, many of them working in top software firms, an overwhelming response.

sections.label: Cessation of 2G mobile services
sections.summary: The cessation of 2G mobile services is not expected to affect many people, as 2G subscriptions are less than 3% of total mobile subscriptions.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: Some disruptions are easier to manage, such as the cessation of 2G mobile services that Mr Pritam Singh highlighted.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: This is not expected to affect many people, as 2G subscriptions comprise less than 3% of the total mobile subscriptions in Singapore today.

sections.label: Internet connectivity for excluded groups
sections.summary: More than 29,000 low-income households have been connected since 2006, and Internet usage by seniors aged 50 and above rose from 33% in 2012 to 51% in 2014.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: We must ensure that no segment of the community is excluded from computer and Internet connectivity, especially low-income households, the elderly and people with special needs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: We have, to date, connected more than 29,000 low-income households since 2006.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: Internet usage by our seniors aged 50 and above has also increased significantly from 33% in 2012 to 51% in 2014.

sections.label: Tech Able beneficiary working at SingTel
sections.summary: Through SG Enable's Programme at Tech Able, she found a job in SingTel as a Call Centre Operator and is now part of the digital economy.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: She has benefited from some of the technology-driven programmes and devices we have put in place, and through SG Enable's Programme at Tech Able, she is now working as part of our digital economy.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: She has benefited from Tech Able and is now an active contributor to our digital economy, having found a job in SingTel as a Call Centre Operator.

sections.label: Review of Okto and Channel U
sections.summary: The speaker asks for details about the Ministry's review of Okto and Channel U.

sentences.speaker: Mr Vikram Nair
sentences.text: In this regard, I would also be interested to know the details about the Ministry's review of Okto and Channel U.

sections.label: PSB relevance, funding, spectrum
sections.summary: The speaker asks what the Ministry is doing to keep PSB relevant, whether PSB funding could extend to more media organisations, and calls for relocating spectrum to schools and the arts community.

sentences.speaker: Mr Darryl David
sentences.text: Like Mr Nair, I would like to ask what the Ministry is doing to ensure that PSB remains relevant and continues to capture Singapore viewers, in particular, the young.

sentences.speaker: Mr Darryl David
sentences.text: I also have another question for the Ministry whether they would consider extending PSB funding to more media organisations and companies if they meet the PSB criteria?

sentences.speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat (Hougang)
sentences.text: I call upon the regulatory authority to relocate some of this spectrum to support the schools and the arts community under the Public Service Broadcast (PSB) framework.

sections.label: Scheme for scriptwriter mentors
sections.summary: The speaker asks whether the Ministry could consider a special scheme for PSB operators to bring in scriptwriters to mentor local content providers and uplift local content quality.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: I agree with hon Member Darryl David, and also Alfred Hitchcock as well, that the good movies and good TV programmes start with the script, the script and the script.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: So, can the Ministry consider a special scheme to have our PSB operators bring in good scriptwriters or screenwriters to mentor our local content providers as well as, in the short term, uplift the quality of local content?

sections.label: Word gap between rich and poor children
sections.summary: Richer parents spend more time reading and talking with their children, producing a 32-million-word gap by age four.

sentences.speaker: Ms Kuik Shiao-Yin (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: They discovered that richer parents spend more time reading and talking with their children than poorer parents do.

sentences.speaker: Ms Kuik Shiao-Yin (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: That means that by the time both the poor kid and the rich kid hit four years old, there is a 32-million-word gap that exists between them.

sections.label: Sesame Street's 1969 origins
sections.summary: Sesame Street began in 1969 as an experiment to prepare poor pre-schoolers for school.

sentences.speaker: Ms Kuik Shiao-Yin (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Sesame Street was born in 1969 as an experiment designed to prepare poor pre-schoolers for school.

sections.label: Sesame Street's documented educational impact
sections.summary: Sesame Street's positive educational impact is well documented, regarded by some as the most cost-effective early childhood education intervention in the US and the first massive open online course for children.

sentences.speaker: Ms Kuik Shiao-Yin (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Its positive impact on education of kids in America and all around the world has been well documented.

sentences.speaker: Ms Kuik Shiao-Yin (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: It is regarded by some as the most cost-effective and impactful early childhood education intervention ever implemented in the US, and it was essentially the first massive open online course freely available for children.

sections.label: Pioneer Generation Package campaign communications
sections.summary: The Pioneer Generation Package campaign showed Government flexibility in customising communications across channels, races and age groups, including dialect.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: The Pioneer Generation Package campaign was a good example of how the Government showed much flexibility in its communications across channels, be it on TV, video and publicity material on the ground, customising the approaches to engage different races and age groups, even selling its messages in dialect.

sections.label: Government communications initiatives and narrowcasts
sections.summary: The Government has rolled out communications initiatives, including the Pioneer Generation Package campaign, as future success requires tailored narrowcasts for specific audiences.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Teng Koon (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: The days of one message being broadcast on one or two channels are gone, and winning in the future will require the ability to tailor "narrowcasts" for specific audiences, when necessary Recognising these challenges, the Government has already rolled out several communications initiatives, including the Pioneer Generation Package (PGP) campaign.

sections.label: National Translation Committee set up
sections.summary: The National Translation Committee was set up in 2014 to improve the quality of translations across the whole of Government.

sentences.speaker: Mr Vikram Nair
sentences.text: (In Tamil):   The National Translation Committee (NTC) was set up in 2014 to improve the quality of translations across the whole of Government.

sections.label: Design 2025 outcomes and SG-Mark
sections.summary: Questions were asked on Design 2025 outcomes and indicators and plans to expand Singapore Design Mark globally, with Singapore named a UNESCO Creative City of Design in 2015.

sentences.speaker: Dr Teo Ho Pin (Bukit Panjang)
sentences.text: One, what are the desired outcomes and key performance indicators of the Design 2025 Masterplan?

sentences.speaker: Dr Teo Ho Pin (Bukit Panjang)
sentences.text: Three, what plans are in place to expand Singapore Design Mark (SG-Mark) globally?

sentences.speaker: Mr Darryl David
sentences.text: We have continued to grow the Singapore design brand globally, culminating in 2015 when Singapore was designated a UNESCO Creative City of Design.

sections.label: Design 2025 Masterplan strategic thrusts
sections.summary: Dr Teo Ho Pin mentioned the Design 2025 Masterplan, which is the way forward for design and creative industries and maps out strategic thrusts and focus areas.

sentences.speaker: Mr Darryl David
sentences.text: My Parliamentary colleague, Dr Teo Ho Pin already mentioned the Design 2025 Masterplan, which is the way forward for the design and creative industries and has mapped out several strategic thrusts and focus areas.

sections.label: Design accreditation for design sectors
sections.summary: The Singapore Institute of Landscape Architects has moved towards accreditation for landscape architects, and an update was sought on design accreditation plans for other sectors.

sentences.speaker: Mr Darryl David
sentences.text: For example, right now, anyone with a bit of aesthetic-sense can call themselves an interior designer.

sentences.speaker: Mr Darryl David
sentences.text: I understand that the Singapore Institute of Landscape Architects (SILA) has taken a step forward towards accreditation for landscape architects.

sentences.speaker: Mr Darryl David
sentences.text: Can the Ministry provide an update on the plans for possible design accreditation for other sectors in the design industry?

sections.label: Smaller libraries in new estates
sections.summary: An MP asks whether the Ministry can support community children's libraries or interim container libraries so young residents in new estates like Punggol get earlier access to books.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Further, to increase the marketing of reading, I would like to enquire if there can be pockets of smaller libraries so as to capture mindshare.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: I understand that the Ministry has a current planning parameter for a library to every 150,000 residents.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: But for new estates like Punggol, which has many residents with young children, proximity to libraries is important.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Can the Ministry consider supporting community children's libraries or building interim container libraries, such as the one in Sengkang, so that young residents can have earlier access to books?

sections.label: Singapore Memory Project interest
sections.summary: Since 2011, the Singapore Memory Project movement has helped generate significant public interest in our history as a people.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Teng Koon
sentences.text: Since 2011, the Singapore Memory Project movement has helped to generate significant public interest in our history as a people.

sections.label: PSB funding last financial year
sections.summary: In the last financial year, $250 million of PSB funding was provided, almost double the amount three years earlier.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: In the last financial year, we provided $250 million of PSB funding, almost double the amount three years earlier.

sections.label: PSB outsourcing to independent companies
sections.summary: Most PSB programmes are produced by Mediacorp, but a significant proportion is outsourced to independent production companies and will continue to be.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: While most PSB programmes are produced by Mediacorp, a significant proportion is outsourced to independent production companies and will continue to be the case.

sections.label: Strengthening PSB in digital age
sections.summary: Several Members asked what is being done to strengthen PSB in a digital age, and it will be strengthened by focusing on three "C"s: content, channels and capabilities.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: Several other Members, including Mr Zaqy Mohamad, Mr Vikram Nair and Mr Darryl David, have also asked what we are doing to strengthen PSB in a digital age.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: We will strengthen PSB by focusing on three "C"s: content, channels and capabilities.

sections.label: MDA and HBO Asia collaboration
sections.summary: Last December, MDA and HBO Asia announced a two-year collaboration to raise local capabilities in drama production.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: Last December, MDA and HBO Asia announced a two-year collaboration to raise local capabilities in drama production.

sections.label: Toggle viewership growth
sections.summary: Toggle's viewership has grown eight times within three years.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: Within three years, Toggle's viewership has grown eight times.

sections.label: Toggle original programmes for younger viewers
sections.summary: Over the next two years, Toggle will release 11 original programmes aimed at younger viewers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: Over the next two years, Toggle will release a slate of 11 original programmes aimed at younger viewers.

sections.label: Mediacorp operations review
sections.summary: Mediacorp and shareholder Temasek Holdings decided to review Mediacorp's operations, as other public broadcasters also review their structure, strategy and funding models.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: Besides BBC, other public broadcasters like RTHK in Hong Kong and NOS in the Netherlands, also regularly review their structure, strategy and funding models.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
